title: juncus bulbosus subsp. kochii
intro: Juncus bulbosus subsp. kochii, commonly known as Rush or Bulbous Rush, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Juncaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Juncus bulbosus subsp. kochii include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating bronchitis and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its therapeutic effects.
